judgments.reason: The model_articulation notes the 3-coin commission reduces effective cost but does not claim the commission is credited before payment or that bids may validly exceed available coins. It therefore does not support the hypothesis that bids above available coins can win due to commission ordering.
The model_articulation treats rival bids as sealed and does not claim that waiting reveals already committed sealed rival bids prior to committing your own, so it does not support this hypothesis.

The model_articulation describes using close after all three lots are sold and does not state that close can settle the game while lots remain unauctioned; it does not articulate the claimed terminal-condition behavior.

The model_articulation explicitly distinguishes catalog purchases from auction wins and attributes the 3-coin commission to auction winners; it does not claim catalog purchases receive the auction commission, so it does not support objective substitution.
